name: publish_product
goal: Create and publish a sellable product listing

steps.intent: start creating a new sellable item
steps.expected_state: a product creation form is visible
steps.success_condition: a form with name, price, and image fields is on screen
the form shows the provided name and price
an image preview appears on the listing
a public product card is visible

final_success_condition: a sellable product card exists with the given name, price, and image
